results.text:
# Alta | AI GTM System of Actions

Alta | AI GTM System of Actions is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Alta is an AI-powered platform that helps boost revenue engines. They offer a range of products and resources for outbound and growth agents, as well as resources for sales insights and ebooks. Alta | AI GTM System of Actions employs 73 people (+143.3% YoY, +43 people), founded in 2023. Headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel, with presence in United States. Its workforce is distributed across 6 countries (including Israel, United States, Canada, Georgia, and Ireland).

## About

For decades, go-to-market teams had systems to store data and plan campaigns. But who actually does the work?
Alta is the AI GTM System of Actions — one AI system for your entire go-to-market. Instead of stitching together 10+ tools across prospecting, outreach, calling, lead qualification, ad targeting, and pipeline analytics, GTM teams use Alta's self-optimizing AI agents to execute the full top-of-funnel — from first signal to booked meeting — getting smarter with every interaction.

Katie — AI SDR Agent
Researches accounts using CRM data and 50+ external sources, identifies high-intent prospects based on real buying signals, and runs personalized multi-channel outreach across email, LinkedIn, and calls. Katie syncs audience data with ad platforms like Google Ads and Meta to align outbound with paid campaigns — automatically.

Alex — AI Calling & Inbound Agent
Qualifies inbound leads and handles outbound calls with human-quality AI conversations. Alex scores intent, routes qualified buyers to your team, books meetings directly into your calendar, and drives account growth through cross-sell and upsell. Insights from every conversation feed back into targeting and ad audiences.

Luna — AI Growth & Intelligence Agent
The intelligence layer that connects it all. Luna surfaces real-time pipeline insights, identifies bottlenecks, alerts teams to key changes, and integrates with CRMs, ad platforms, and 50+ data sources — giving your entire GTM team full visibility without manual work.
All three agents share one brain. Inbound data sharpens outbound targeting. Outbound engagement optimizes ad audiences. Channel preferences are learned automatically. Every interaction compounds to make the system smarter.
One platform. Three AI agents. Zero busywork.
Trusted by leading B2B companies including Snowflake, Deel, and Riverside. Integrates with HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Ads, Meta, Slack, and 50+ platforms. SOC 2 and ISO certified.
AI acts. Your team wins.
